rationale: RQ-SNN-005 asks whether STDP improves functional learning performance relative to no STDP. Earlier exploratory runs were incomplete or provenance-limited. This prospective run uses the existing native association holdout task with matched learning-off, sham-replay, post-acquisition weight-reset and weight-shuffle controls, fresh held-out test episodes, and frozen weights during evaluation.

test_constraints: teacher absent during every test episode
LearningEngine detached during every test episode
same held-out test-input digest across all five arms within each seed

analysis_plan.test: exact two-sided paired sign-flip over 16 seed-level accuracy differences
analysis_plan.interval: 2000-resample paired percentile bootstrap 95% CI using the existing deterministic paired_summary implementation
analysis_plan.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the four declared learning_on-control comparisons
decision_rule: all 80 runs and all 16x5 seed-condition cells must be present
all runs must contain exactly 40 holdout episodes and 12 ticks per episode
test teacher must be absent and test LearningEngine detached in every run
weights must be unchanged across every holdout evaluation
within each seed all five conditions must share the same test_input_digest
learning_on minus learning_off mean test_accuracy difference must be >= 0.10
the primary bootstrap 95% CI lower bound must be > 0
the Holm-adjusted primary sign-flip p-value must be < 0.05
learning_on mean accuracy must exceed each sham/reset/shuffle control mean accuracy
each robustness contrast must have positive mean difference and Holm-adjusted p < 0.05

freshness_rule: Seeds 7601-7616 are disjoint from the earlier native association seeds 20001-20010 and recent Stage-1/REC clean-run seed ranges.
integrity_constraints: execute in the isolated experiment worktree
primary checkout remains clean before and after execution
scientific source digest must equal the currently verified digest before execution
no modification of src/, configs/, tests/, research/schemas/ or pyproject.toml
no outcome-based retries, seed replacement or parameter retuning
claim_boundary: A supported result would show only that the registered STDP-enabled synthetic association protocol achieves higher held-out classification accuracy than matched no-learning/sham/reset/shuffle controls within this simulator and task. It does not establish general intelligence, open-world learning, biological equivalence, human-like memory, scaling, a 5D advantage, external independent replication or human-reviewed EVID.
